newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's O/N rates ease to 19.625 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's O/N rates ease to 19.625 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates eased in abundant liquidity on Monday, traders said.
Overnight rates closed at 19.625 percent, down from Friday's close of 19.875/20.125 percent.
Traders said the downward movement was surprising especially considering the fact that the central bank's one-week reverse repo facility stands at 20.00 percent.
"This drop was all the more surprising because (market participants) have the one-week reverse repo available which offers a higher interest rate," said Sandor Szatmari of Creditanstalt.
He said that overnight rates would probably stay around current levels or rise slightly in coming days.
